product_boundary: Identity credentials, federation, OIDC, SCIM, passkeys, and opaque subject references.

next_actions.success: Verify the exact contract version and continue the approved identity federation workflow.
next_actions.rejection: Preserve current authoritative state and show the customer the rejected identity federation requirement.
next_actions.timeout: Retry within the bounded budget or route the identity federation workflow to an operator without duplicating authority.
next_actions.duplicate: Return the prior idempotent identity federation result and do not repeat side effects.
next_actions.rollback: Restore the last verified identity federation contract or projection while preserving immutable evidence.
